title: Spare Key — Chapter 7
narration: She wasn't the baby you stole, Claire repeated. My son was. I stared at Sophie's DNA report. Claire said we had given birth in the same clinic, three days apart. Adam switched our babies before either of us went home. Why would he do that? Because your son was sick, she said. Mine wasn't. A memory surfaced: two cradles, Adam removing the name cards, and a doctor counting cash. Sophie returned holding Adam's key. Daddy says the other child is waiting. She led us to the maintenance shed and unlocked a door beneath the floor. Inside was a nursery untouched for years. Two names were painted above the beds: Sophie and Thomas. On one pillow lay a school photograph of a boy. He had Adam's eyes. Beneath it was our home address. My phone showed a security alert. A boy stood inside Sophie's bedroom. He looked into the camera. Mum, why did you choose her?
